name: Love on Fire, Honey on Trial
original_name: Love on Fire, Honey on Trial
overview: The president's dual identity, a light comedy, adapted from a popular domestic novel. Edith Blair had been in a loveless and sexless arranged marriage for three years. When she found out that her sexy firefighter husband had gotten another woman pregnant, she demanded a divorce! Even though it meant burying her decade - long secret love for him! However, her husband refused to sign the divorce papers unless she agreed to act as a loving couple with him for one last month... Then, Edith was surprised to discover that a huge misunderstanding stood between her and her husband...
